image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a brown tabby cat sitting on a grey carpet. The cat has its eyes closed in a relaxed or sleeping state. Distinctive tabby markings are visible, including the 'M' shape on the forehead and dark stripes on the cheeks and body. The fur texture appears dense and realistic.
